Attack.description: IntentType 枚举值 `Attack`。成员意图类：SingleAttackIntent、MultiAttackIntent。
Attack.name: Attack
Attack.play_notes: Incoming single attack — the label number is the live damage preview (Strength/Weak/Vulnerable already applied, floored at 0). Compare damage vs your Block + HP; Weak on the attacker cuts it (x0.75 per stack).

Buff.description: IntentType 枚举值 `Buff`。成员意图类：BuffIntent。
Buff.name: Buff
Buff.play_notes: Enemy self/allied buff this turn (Strength, Ritual, stances, some summons). Free damage window if you can race the ramp — check monsters.json move effect for the exact buff before ignoring.

BuffIntent.decision_rule: Enemy self/allied buff this turn (Strength, Ritual, stances, some summons). Free damage window if you can race the ramp — check monsters.json move effect for the exact buff before ignoring.
BuffIntent.description: 敌人自我/友方强化（力量、仪式、姿态、 部分招式的召唤等）。loc 中标签为 FORMAT_EMPTY → bridge 服务端替换为 意图类型；紧凑视图显示 `Buff` 或 `Buff(招式id)`（如 `Buff(PREPARE_MOVE)`）。
BuffIntent.label_semantics: enemy buffs itself / allies (Strength, Ritual, stances, summons in some moves). Label is FORMAT_EMPTY in loc → bridge replaces with the intent type; compact shows `Buff` or `Buff(move_id)` (e.g. `Buff(PREPARE_MOVE)`).
BuffIntent.name: BuffIntent
BuffIntent.play_notes: 敌人自我/友方强化（力量、仪式、姿态、 部分招式的召唤等）。loc 中标签为 FORMAT_EMPTY → bridge 服务端替换为 意图类型；紧凑视图显示 `Buff` 或 `Buff(招式id)`（如 `Buff(PREPARE_MOVE)`）。

CardDebuff.description: IntentType 枚举值 `CardDebuff`。成员意图类：CardDebuffIntent。
CardDebuff.name: CardDebuff
CardDebuff.play_notes: Injects status/curse cards into player piles (sometimes combined with attack on the same move). Treat as deck pollution unless the move table also lists an attack — then plan block for the attack half.

CardDebuffIntent.decision_rule: Injects status/curse cards into player piles (sometimes combined with attack on the same move). Treat as deck pollution unless the move table also lists an attack — then plan block for the attack half.
CardDebuffIntent.description: 向玩家牌堆注入状态/诅咒牌 （常与攻击同招）。loc 标签为 FORMAT_EMPTY → 紧凑视图回退为 `CardDebuff(招式id)`。按「牌组污染」应对，而非伤害——除非该招同时带 攻击（见下条组合标签）。
CardDebuffIntent.label_semantics: injects status/curse cards into the player's piles (often combined with an attack on the same move). Label is FORMAT_EMPTY → compact falls back to `CardDebuff(move_id)`. Treat as deck pollution incoming, not damage — unless the move also carries an attack (see combined labels below).
CardDebuffIntent.name: CardDebuffIntent
CardDebuffIntent.play_notes: 向玩家牌堆注入状态/诅咒牌 （常与攻击同招）。loc 标签为 FORMAT_EMPTY → 紧凑视图回退为 `CardDebuff(招式id)`。按「牌组污染」应对，而非伤害——除非该招同时带 攻击（见下条组合标签）。

DeathBlow.description: IntentType 枚举值 `DeathBlow`。成员意图类：DeathBlowIntent。
DeathBlow.name: DeathBlow
DeathBlow.play_notes: Lethal-styled single attack (DeathBlow icon). Same math as SingleAttackIntent — treat as ordinary attack damage; block or kill.

DeathBlowIntent.decision_rule: Lethal-styled single attack (DeathBlow icon). Same math as SingleAttackIntent — treat as ordinary attack damage; block or kill.
DeathBlowIntent.description: SingleAttackIntent 子类， 使用致死一击图标——攻击语义不变；标签仍为伤害数字。
DeathBlowIntent.label_semantics: SingleAttackIntent subclass with death-blow icon — a lethal-styled attack; label is still the damage number.
DeathBlowIntent.name: DeathBlowIntent
DeathBlowIntent.play_notes: SingleAttackIntent 子类， 使用致死一击图标——攻击语义不变；标签仍为伤害数字。

Debuff.description: IntentType 枚举值 `Debuff`。成员意图类：DebuffIntent。
Debuff.name: Debuff
Debuff.play_notes: Enemy applies debuffs (Vulnerable/Weak/Frail/Poison/card afflictions). No direct damage — often a setup turn; Artifact blocks one visible debuff application; plan burst timing around the debuff window.

DebuffIntent.decision_rule: Enemy applies debuffs (Vulnerable/Weak/Frail/Poison/card afflictions). No direct damage — often a setup turn; Artifact blocks one visible debuff application; plan burst timing around the debuff window.
DebuffIntent.description: 敌人施加减益 （易伤、虚弱、中毒、脆弱、卡牌绑定减益等）。紧凑视图显示 `Debuff`； strong=true 时为 `DebuffStrong`。
DebuffIntent.label_semantics: enemy applies debuffs (Vulnerable, Weak, Poison, Frail, card afflictions, etc.). Compact shows `Debuff`, or `DebuffStrong` when constructed with strong=true.
DebuffIntent.name: DebuffIntent
DebuffIntent.play_notes: 敌人施加减益 （易伤、虚弱、中毒、脆弱、卡牌绑定减益等）。紧凑视图显示 `Debuff`； strong=true 时为 `DebuffStrong`。

DebuffStrong.description: IntentType 枚举值 `DebuffStrong`。成员意图类：DebuffIntent。
DebuffStrong.name: DebuffStrong
DebuffStrong.play_notes: Enemy applies debuffs (Vulnerable/Weak/Frail/Poison/card afflictions). No direct damage — often a setup turn; Artifact blocks one visible debuff application; plan burst timing around the debuff window.

Defend.description: IntentType 枚举值 `Defend`。成员意图类：DefendIntent。
Defend.name: Defend
Defend.play_notes: Enemy gains Block this turn — a low-threat turn; pile damage now or prepare Vulnerable for after the block decays.

DefendIntent.decision_rule: Enemy gains Block this turn — a low-threat turn; pile damage now or prepare Vulnerable for after the block decays.
DefendIntent.description: 敌人本回合获得格挡。显示 `Defend`。
DefendIntent.label_semantics: enemy gains Block this turn. Compact shows `Defend`.
DefendIntent.name: DefendIntent
DefendIntent.play_notes: 敌人本回合获得格挡。显示 `Defend`。

Escape.description: IntentType 枚举值 `Escape`。成员意图类：EscapeIntent。
Escape.name: Escape
Escape.play_notes: Enemy flees combat this turn — kill it NOW or it escapes at current HP (often unrewarded). Flutter/escape-timer counters can flip this intent if resolved first.

EscapeIntent.decision_rule: Enemy flees combat this turn — kill it NOW or it escapes at current HP (often unrewarded). Flutter/escape-timer counters can flip this intent if resolved first.
EscapeIntent.description: 敌人本回合逃离战斗。显示 `Escape`。
EscapeIntent.label_semantics: enemy flees combat this turn. Compact shows `Escape`.
EscapeIntent.name: EscapeIntent
EscapeIntent.play_notes: 敌人本回合逃离战斗。显示 `Escape`。

Heal.description: IntentType 枚举值 `Heal`。成员意图类：HealIntent。
Heal.name: Heal
Heal.play_notes: Enemy heals (also revive moves like REVIVE_MOVE). Kill-pressure turn: race the heal or re-apply kill-window conditions.

HealIntent.decision_rule: Enemy heals (also revive moves like REVIVE_MOVE). Kill-pressure turn: race the heal or re-apply kill-window conditions.
HealIntent.description: 敌人治疗（也用于复活招式，如 IllusionPower 的 REVIVE_MOVE）。显示 `Heal`。
HealIntent.label_semantics: enemy heals (also used by revive moves, e.g. IllusionPower REVIVE_MOVE). Compact shows `Heal`.
HealIntent.name: HealIntent
HealIntent.play_notes: 敌人治疗（也用于复活招式，如 IllusionPower 的 REVIVE_MOVE）。显示 `Heal`。

Hidden.description: IntentType 枚举值 `Hidden`。成员意图类：HiddenIntent。
Hidden.name: Hidden
Hidden.play_notes: No sprite, no hover tip — action fully hidden. Play safe: keep block/economy; check monsters.json for hidden-move pools (e.g. burrowed BELOW_MOVE).

HiddenIntent.decision_rule: No sprite, no hover tip — action fully hidden. Play safe: keep block/economy; check monsters.json for hidden-move pools (e.g. burrowed BELOW_MOVE).
HiddenIntent.description: 无图标、无悬浮提示——行动完全隐藏。 显示 `Hidden`。
HiddenIntent.label_semantics: no sprite, no hover tip — action fully hidden. Compact shows `Hidden`.
HiddenIntent.name: HiddenIntent
HiddenIntent.play_notes: 无图标、无悬浮提示——行动完全隐藏。 显示 `Hidden`。

MultiAttackIntent.decision_rule: Incoming multi-hit attack — label shows per-hit x hits; total = per-hit x hits. Block absorbs EACH hit separately, so high Block is twice as effective here. Weak cuts the per-hit number.
MultiAttackIntent.description: 攻击 Repeats 次。标签 = FORMAT_DAMAGE_MULTI（Damage + Repeat）→ 紧凑视图显示 每段×次数， 如 `3×7`（7 段每段 3；总伤 = 每段 × 次数）。每段数字同样为实时预览。
MultiAttackIntent.label_semantics: attack Repeats times. Label = FORMAT_DAMAGE_MULTI with Damage + Repeat → compact shows per-hit × hits, e.g. `3×7` (7 hits of 3; total = per-hit × hits). Same live-preview rule for the per-hit number.
MultiAttackIntent.name: MultiAttackIntent
MultiAttackIntent.play_notes: 攻击 Repeats 次。标签 = FORMAT_DAMAGE_MULTI（Damage + Repeat）→ 紧凑视图显示 每段×次数， 如 `3×7`（7 段每段 3；总伤 = 每段 × 次数）。每段数字同样为实时预览。

SingleAttackIntent.decision_rule: Incoming single attack — the label number is the live damage preview (Strength/Weak/Vulnerable already applied, floored at 0). Compare damage vs your Block + HP; Weak on the attacker cuts it (x0.75 per stack).
SingleAttackIntent.description: 单次攻击。标签 = FORMAT_DAMAGE_SINGLE → 紧凑视图显示伤害数字，如 `8`。该数字是游戏内 实时伤害预览（`GetSingleDamage` 会跑伤害 hook，下限 0）——已包含 力量/虚弱/易伤等修正，并非招式原始值。
SingleAttackIntent.label_semantics: attack once. Label = FORMAT_DAMAGE_SINGLE → compact shows the damage number, e.g. `8`. The number is the game's live damage preview (`GetSingleDamage` runs damage hooks, floored at 0) — it already includes Strength/Weak/Vulnerable-style modifiers, not the raw move value.
SingleAttackIntent.name: SingleAttackIntent
SingleAttackIntent.play_notes: 单次攻击。标签 = FORMAT_DAMAGE_SINGLE → 紧凑视图显示伤害数字，如 `8`。该数字是游戏内 实时伤害预览（`GetSingleDamage` 会跑伤害 hook，下限 0）——已包含 力量/虚弱/易伤等修正，并非招式原始值。

Sleep.description: IntentType 枚举值 `Sleep`。成员意图类：SleepIntent。
Sleep.name: Sleep
Sleep.play_notes: Enemy sleeps/skips action (AsleepPower/SlumberPower stances). Free damage window — but unblocked card damage wakes sleepers (strips Plating + Asleep, flips to Stun); decide deliberately between free hits and controlled wake-stun.

SleepIntent.decision_rule: Enemy sleeps/skips action (AsleepPower/SlumberPower stances). Free damage window — but unblocked card damage wakes sleepers (strips Plating + Asleep, flips to Stun); decide deliberately between free hits and controlled wake-stun.
SleepIntent.description: 敌人沉睡/跳过行动（AsleepPower / SlumberPower 姿态）。显示 `Sleep`。
SleepIntent.label_semantics: enemy sleeps / skips action (AsleepPower / SlumberPower stances). Compact shows `Sleep`.
SleepIntent.name: SleepIntent
SleepIntent.play_notes: 敌人沉睡/跳过行动（AsleepPower / SlumberPower 姿态）。显示 `Sleep`。

StatusCard.description: IntentType 枚举值 `StatusCard`。成员意图类：StatusIntent。
StatusCard.name: StatusCard
StatusCard.play_notes: Adds status/curse cards to player piles — card_count = number of cards. No direct damage; deck pollution incoming. Thin with exhaust/draw tools; status cards are usually unplayable clog.

StatusIntent.decision_rule: Adds status/curse cards to player piles — card_count = number of cards. No direct damage; deck pollution incoming. Thin with exhaust/draw tools; status cards are usually unplayable clog.
StatusIntent.description: 向玩家牌堆加入 `count` 张状态牌， 无直接伤害。标签 = FORMAT_STATUS_CARD_COUNT → 紧凑视图显示卡牌数量。
StatusIntent.label_semantics: adds `count` status cards to the player's piles, no direct damage. Label = FORMAT_STATUS_CARD_COUNT → compact shows the card count.
StatusIntent.name: StatusIntent
StatusIntent.play_notes: 向玩家牌堆加入 `count` 张状态牌， 无直接伤害。标签 = FORMAT_STATUS_CARD_COUNT → 紧凑视图显示卡牌数量。

Stun.description: IntentType 枚举值 `Stun`。成员意图类：StunIntent。
Stun.name: Stun
Stun.play_notes: Enemy stunned/skips action this turn (burrow break, wake-up stuns, Imbalanced). Pure free-damage window — spend it.

StunIntent.decision_rule: Enemy stunned/skips action this turn (burrow break, wake-up stuns, Imbalanced). Pure free-damage window — spend it.
StunIntent.description: 敌人被击晕/本回合跳过行动（钻地破防、 醒来眩晕、Imbalanced 等）。显示 `Stun`。
StunIntent.label_semantics: enemy is stunned / skips action this turn (Burrowed break, wake-up stuns, Imbalanced, etc.). Compact shows `Stun`.
StunIntent.name: StunIntent
StunIntent.play_notes: 敌人被击晕/本回合跳过行动（钻地破防、 醒来眩晕、Imbalanced 等）。显示 `Stun`。

Summon.description: IntentType 枚举值 `Summon`。成员意图类：SummonIntent。
Summon.name: Summon
Summon.play_notes: Enemy summons adds this turn. Master-minion doctrine usually applies: killing the summoner despawns/clears adds; check the monster entry before switching targets.

SummonIntent.decision_rule: Enemy summons adds this turn. Master-minion doctrine usually applies: killing the summoner despawns/clears adds; check the monster entry before switching targets.
SummonIntent.description: 敌人本回合召唤小怪。显示 `Summon`。
SummonIntent.label_semantics: enemy summons adds this turn. Compact shows `Summon`.
SummonIntent.name: SummonIntent
SummonIntent.play_notes: 敌人本回合召唤小怪。显示 `Summon`。

Unknown.description: IntentType 枚举值 `Unknown`。成员意图类：UnknownIntent。
Unknown.name: Unknown
Unknown.play_notes: Action not yet revealed. Treat as unknown threat — keep defensive posture and consult the monster move table.

UnknownIntent.decision_rule: Action not yet revealed. Treat as unknown threat — keep defensive posture and consult the monster move table.
UnknownIntent.description: 行动尚未揭示；稍后或满足条件后 揭示。显示 `Unknown`。
UnknownIntent.label_semantics: action not yet revealed; revealed later or after conditions. Compact shows `Unknown`.
UnknownIntent.name: UnknownIntent
UnknownIntent.play_notes: 行动尚未揭示；稍后或满足条件后 揭示。显示 `Unknown`。
